title: Immutable solvated-ellipsoid MD initialization
summary: For every solution MD request, construct a spherical solvent bath around a principal-axis solute, carve its cavity, deform and clip the bath to the target ellipsoid, and keep the solute pose fixed for propagation and restart; pure-solvent MD is exempt.
gates: exactly one count-one solute and one solvent species
ARCHITECT spherical-parent cavity deformation and whole-molecule clipping
explicit ellipsoid derived from principal-frame solute bounds, solvent vdW diameter, shell count and end clearance
immutable zero solute mobility, momentum and pose across propagation and restart
coordinate_policy: Place the solute geometric centre at the ellipsoid centre, align it with deterministic principal axes, and preserve that initial pose exactly.
backend_policy: KEYMAKER delegates construction to ARCHITECT, confinement to EPOC and rigid propagation to MIFUNE; no solution-MD backend may bypass the frozen packing.
